name: Vulpix
description: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

moves.name: Ember
moves.description: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts, raising the user's offensive stats.

moves.name: Flame Wheel
moves.description: The user cloaks itself in flames and charges at the target to deal damage. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Hex
moves.description: The user attacks with relentless intensity. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user restores its own HP but also becomes drowsy.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target.

moves.name: Ominous Wind
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.name: Mystical Fire
moves.description: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's offensive stats.

moves.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.description: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes. This lowers the target’s offensive stats.
